name: Taxation Basis 5 Code
definition: Specifies the tax or charge basis.

FLAT.name: Flat
FLAT.definition: Charge/tax basis is a lump sum.

GRAM.name: Gross Amount
GRAM.definition: Charge/Commission/tax basis is based on the gross amount.

NEAM.name: Net Amount
NEAM.definition: Charge/commission/tax basis is based on the net amount.

PERU.name: Per Unit
PERU.definition: Charges/tax basis is per unit of financial instrument.
